text:
Tess - Marketing: Quick sync: launching a small 'Starter Pack' for community workshops. Deliverables: 1) 800-word launch post, 2) 30-min webinar + live repo walkthrough, 3) email drip (3 msgs), 4) inbound routing rules. Can we scope?
Jordan - DevRel: I can build the Starter Pack repo (tiny refapp + README + Dockerfile). Aim for zero-config: `docker run` to start. Also include a one-file terraform snippet for optional infra.
Omar - Growth: Good. For acquisition, short headline variants: "Starter Pack: ship a refapp in 30m" and "Hands-on: reproduce our cost bench". I'll A/B test on two segments.
Priya - Product: Bench side: include at least two model/hardware points (e.g., open-13B quant on A100 vs 7B on T4), and a simple table: tokens/sec, median latency, cost/token. Keep it reproducible.
Zoe - Growth Ops: Routing plan: refapp_cta -> self-serve onboarding + send repo link; bench_cta -> nurture + tag bench_interest. If company_size >= 50 -> flag sales_contact. Add hidden field `utm_campaign=ignite_starterpack`.
Tess - Marketing: Draft hero paragraph for blog/email: "Community Ignite: Starter Pack workshops to ship minimal refapps and see real benchmark runs. Code-first, 30 min, free." Thoughts?
Jordan - DevRel: Love it. I'll add a "what you'll need" checklist to the landing: Docker, 10GB disk, optional GPU. Also add a tiny sample dataset and a pre-quantized model so folks can run locally.
Omar - Growth: Social copy candidates:
- ":rocket: New Starter Pack — ship a refapp in 30m. Code + walkthrough + live Q&A: https://go.redwood/ignite?utm_content=starterA"
- ":mag: Live bench: see how batching + quant lowered token cost in real runs. Join: https://go.redwood/ignite?utm_content=benchB"
Priya - Product: For the benchmark narrative, add a short 'how we measured' blurb and link to the runbook in the repo. Keep numbers rounded and reproducible.
Zoe - Growth Ops: Implementation checklist for me: 1) Add hidden utm fields in form; 2) Create tags: starterpack, bench_interest; 3) Auto-assign bench leads with >100k qps flag to SE pipeline; 4) Pixel on landing. I can have rules in 12h.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: editorial review in 36 hours.
Tess - Marketing: Email flow plan: Day0 welcome + repo, Day2 bench highlights + invite to live run, Day6 replay + next steps. Omar will provide subject lines.
Jordan - DevRel: Repo layout I'll push: `/starter/README.md`, `/docker`, `/models/README.md`, `/bench/runbook.md`. Will include a `repro.sh` that automates the bench run (no creds).
Omar - Growth: Subject test ideas: (A) "Ship a refapp in 30 minutes" (B) "Watch our live cost runs: 3x improvements". CTA text test: "Get the Starter Pack" vs "Reserve your seat".
Priya - Product: I'll provide the small metrics table and a 1-sentence Eng quote for social: "Focus on batching, caching, and kernel choice to make inference predictable."
Tess - Marketing: Owners + due dates: Jordan -> repo + runbook (72h), Omar -> email + social variants (36h), Zoe -> routing rules (12h), Priya -> benchmark artifacts (48h), Tess -> blog draft + landing (48h). I'll create GH tickets and a calendar invite.
Jordan - DevRel: One ask: can marketing include a tiny promotional code on the landing to track demo-to-repo conversions? `starter-ignite` label.
Zoe - Growth Ops: Yes, will include `promo_code` hidden param and map to analytics.
Tess - Marketing: Great. We'll iterate on messaging after the first session. Thanks team :sparkles:
